name: io.github.duewalllabs/duewall-adapters
title: DueWall — Tokenized Credit Data
description: Read-only MCP server for DueWall (duewall.com): tokenized private credit data — DLI index, DCR reference rate, debt calendar events (D1/E1/R1), upcoming maturities, human-verified liquidity terms, pool TVL/APY, and claim-vs-observed verification verdicts (three-state, evidence-linked). Bitcoin-anchored, CC-BY.
